```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Cascode gate vbn=0.94 V leaves x=0.14 V, below M1 Vdsat (0.15 V), so M1 and M2 go triode. The PMOS mirror node vbp=0.3 V also pushes Mn into edge-of-saturation. Raise the PMOS mirror gm/Id to lower Vsg and lift vbp, and add headroom checks."}
```

Changes: the PMOS mirror moves to higher gm/Id (lower Vsg, so vbp rises to about 0.6 V, which gives Mn Vds margin), and the cascode bias stays at the lowest reference gm/Id for the largest Vgs. Predictions now include the headroom margins.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":       (16e-6, 12e-6, 30e-6),  # branch current (driver = load)
    "L1":      (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),        # driver length
    "L2":      (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),       # cascode + reference length
    "L3":      (2.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS current-source length
    "gmid2":   (12.0, 9.0, 14.0),      # cascode gm/Id (lower Vov2 keeps Vgs2 moderate)
    "gmid_b":  (2.5, 2.5, 5.0),        # reference gm/Id (min -> largest Vgs -> higher vbn)
    "gmid_p":  (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id (high -> small Vsg -> higher vbp)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    I = p["I"]
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vin = spec["vin_dc"]
    CL = spec["cl"]

    # Driver: width so that Id(vin) = I at Vds ~ 0.9 V
    unit = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L1"], vin, 0.9)
    W1 = max(0.42, I / unit["Id"])
    d1 = lut.op("n", W1, p["L1"], vin, 0.9)

    # NMOS cascode and reference
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I, vds=0.5)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L2"], Iref, vds=0.9)

    # PMOS load and mirror (high gm/Id -> low Vsg -> vbp well above Mn Vdsat)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], I, vds=0.9)
    mbp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], Iref, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["L1"])   # CS driver
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m2)              # NMOS cascode, gate = vbn
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)               # PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("Mref", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)        # diode reference, carries Iref
    n.dev("Mn", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)            # NMOS copy, Iref sinks from vbp
    n.dev("Mbp", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mbp)              # PMOS diode, Iref sourced from vdd

    # First-order predictions
    vbn = mref.vgs
    x = vbn - m2.vgs                       # M1 drain node (cascode source)
    x_margin = x - d1["vdsat"]             # M1 saturation margin (must be > 0)
    vbp = VDD - mbp.vgs                    # PMOS mirror gate voltage
    mn_margin = vbp - mref.vdsat           # Mn saturation margin (must be > 0)
    vmin = x + m2.vdsat                    # lowest saturated output
    vmax = VDD - m3.vdsat                  # highest saturated output
    vdc = 0.5 * (vmin + vmax)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vdc - vmin, vmax - vdc)

    Rcas = (m2.gm / m2.gds) / d1["gds"]    # cascode output resistance
    Rout = 1.0 / (m3.gds + 1.0 / Rcas)
    A = d1["gm"] * Rout
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * CL)
    gbw = d1["gm"] / (2 * PI * CL)
    power = VDD * (I + 2 * Iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vdc,
        "swing": swing,
        "m1_headroom": x_margin,
        "mn_headroom": mn_margin,
    }
```
